title: Telegram Token Configuration Forensic
configuration_mechanism: Environment variable (primary) with .env file support via pydantic-settings
token_flow_trace: 6. TelegramBot passed to NotificationQueue and TelegramWorker

env_file_support.note: .env file is optional; environment variables take precedence

startup_validation.behavior: Warns if TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN not configured (notifications disabled), validates format if present
startup_validation.strict_mode: Available via strict parameter, defaults to False (warn only)

scope_options: Process environment variable (set in terminal session)
User environment variable (System Properties -> Environment Variables -> User variables)
System environment variable (System Properties -> Environment Variables -> System variables)
windows_configuration.recommended: User environment variable for persistence across sessions
windows_configuration.cmd_command:
set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=your_token_here  # temporary
setx TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN your_token_here  # persistent (user scope)

live_test_requirements.behavior: Only sends test messages when both enabled and chat_id matches configured test chat

user_action_required: Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable (and optionally TELEGRAM_LIVE_TEST=true + TELEGRAM_TEST_CHAT_ID for testing)
